question_en: List popular movies happening in Paris
question_fr: Répertorier les films populaires se déroulant à Paris
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION WHERE T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_WIKIDATA = 'Q90' AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative' ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.POPULARITY DESC LIMIT 8
comment: 2026-10-17: refresh SQL moved from the Wikidata V1 tables (T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY P840, T_WC_T2S_ITEM label) to the locations read-model, Paris named by its QID Q90, role narrative.
